# Yu OS SDK

> Build Yu OS Apps in Python, Node.js, Go, or Rust. Call the user's configured AI model through Yu OS, or expose App tools to the system Agent via MCP.

Pick the guide for the direction you need: **App → system AI** or **system Agent → App tool**. Installing the SDK alone does not provide the Yu OS runtime or authorize calls.

- For system AI, see Quickstart. Put the AI verb in `app.json`, e.g. `{"verb":"ai.chat"}`. Omit `scope` and `why`. Use `ai.chat` for text or `ai.infer` for embeddings, TTS, STT, images, and decisions. The user configures the model; the App only sends inputs.
- Optional GUI model permissions are controlled in Settings → Applications. When inference returns `PERMISSION_DENIED` with `detail.reason = "model_permission_required"`, show App-owned copy and let the user open Settings. Do not retry without a user action or let the App approve itself.
- Use a signed `app.json` with `schema_version: 2` and `mcp.tools` for Agent-facing tools. Bind handlers to the declared names. An MCP-only App needs no `operations` or `main.py`. Name a tool `<app-id>.<command>` to expose `yu app <app-id> <command>`.
- Use the Gateway's call context, not tool arguments or environment variables, for caller identity. Keep MCP stdout for protocol messages; log to stderr.
- Use SDK chat with an explicit origin: `trusted` for developer-authored text, `user-input` for typed input, and `external-content` for outside data. Declare the corresponding AI capability and follow the owner consent path. Do not call model providers directly.
- The fixed AI tool catalog is not App MCP. Apps cannot invoke other Apps; the system Agent coordinates them. A manifest request, signature, or install confirmation alone is not a runtime grant.

## Start

- [System AI Quickstart](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiaoyu-work/Yu-OS/main/yuos-sdk/QUICKSTART.md): call `ai.chat` in a two-file App, declare permission, and run it.
- [MCP example](https://github.com/xiaoyu-work/Yu-OS/blob/main/docs/app-development.md#quickstart-an-mcp-only-app): expose a tool to the CLI and system Agent without calling a model.
- [Python](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiaoyu-work/Yu-OS/main/yuos-sdk/python/README.md): `App.from_manifest()`, `@app.tool`, `ai.chat`.
- [Node.js](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiaoyu-work/Yu-OS/main/yuos-sdk/node/README.md): `mcp.App.fromManifest()`, `app.tool`, `await ai.chat`; pass the MCP `signal`.
- [Go](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiaoyu-work/Yu-OS/main/yuos-sdk/go/README.md): `LoadMCPApp`, `Bind`, `ServeStdio`; pass `MCPCall` to `ChatContext`.
- [Rust](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiaoyu-work/Yu-OS/main/yuos-sdk/rust/README.md): `mcp::App::from_environment`, `Tool`, `serve_stdio`, `ai::chat`.

## Reference

- [App guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiaoyu-work/Yu-OS/main/docs/app-development.md): manifest arguments, permissions, AI consent, and installation.
- [Manifest schema](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiaoyu-work/Yu-OS/main/yuos-sdk/wire/v1/manifest.schema.json): supported fields and types.
- [SDK reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiaoyu-work/Yu-OS/main/yuos-sdk/REFERENCE.md): compatibility, binding coverage, and releases.
- [Wire v1](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiaoyu-work/Yu-OS/main/yuos-sdk/wire/v1/README.md): CLI envelopes, call context, and errors.
